author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a concave six-point cell body with inward-curving sides; each point runs out a short stem that forks into a Y of two dendrites ending on radius 20, as in the reference. A smaller-body candidate (P9, side r7) was rejected: the body waist failed internal spacing and it read as a snowflake. Two wider-spread candidates overshot the CIRCLE envelope after grid rounding. The rejected drawing was a hexagon ring with straight snowflake spokes.
omissions: The reference's slight irregularity between arms is regularised to six-fold symmetry; the dendrites are straight rather than slightly bent.
drawing_plan: Six arms at -90+60k about (24,24): body points r11 joined by concave r10 arcs, stems to r14, dendrites +-40 degrees to r19.9, knots rounded to the grid.
lucide_reference: No Lucide neuron glyph; the concave star of arcs follows Lucide 'star' construction, the forks 'git-fork'/'network' straight branches.
